about: Which Brotato enemies get a Hue colour. First matching row wins. match is checked in code: boss (script is Boss), loot (enemy.is_loot), charmed (charmed effect active), default (everything else).

rows.note: Bosses and elites stay like Hue's black objects: always solid
Loot aliens are never hidden, so they stay catchable
Charmed enemies fight for you and lose their colour
Every other enemy gets one of Hue's owned colours
